_what_this_is: Written by scripts/og_render.mjs. Gate 13 reads it to assert that every preview image's text resolves to a live string in design/copy.yaml or to a field in generated data. An image whose recorded text no longer matches its source is an image advertising something the site stopped saying.

campaign.png.note: ESCALATION, C-18: copy.yaml has no top-level key for /log/, so this route's own preview text does not exist and a packet may not invent one. The site tagline is a real published string and stands in until the build lead writes the /log/ copy. The previous text typed five numbers into a sentence, which rule 2 forbids outright.
